turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How's support been when you've run into issues?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Genuinely excellent. We had a voice cloning artifact issue and got a real engineer on a call within a few hours, not a canned response. They fixed it same day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Anything about support that could improve?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The live chat widget on the dashboard sometimes shows as 'offline' even during business hours, which made us think support wasn't available. We ended up emailing instead.
